title: Pūrṇam Adaḥ
summary: The invocation of the Īśopaniṣad: the Complete Whole remains complete.
about: That is complete, this is complete; from the complete the complete comes, and what remains is still complete. Closes with “oṁ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ”.
author: Vyasadeva
occasions: opening or closing any study or worship

verses.text:
ॐ पूर्णमदः पूर्णमिदं
पूर्णात्पूर्णमुदच्यते
पूर्णस्य पूर्णमादाय
पूर्णमेवावशिष्यते
verses.roman:
oṁ pūrṇam adaḥ pūrṇam idaṁ pūrṇāt pūrṇam udacyate
pūrṇasya pūrṇam ādāya pūrṇam evāvaśiṣyate

selected.why: The page holds the whole Īśopaniṣad; the prayer is its invocation.
